answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 6582 Country: India Title: My question is Is it permited or prohibited to use tongue cleaner in ISLAM? plz give me answer with reference to quran and hadith. Question: As salamo alikum mufti sahab. My question is Is it permited or prohibited to use tongue cleaner in ISLAM? plz give me answer with reference to quran and hadith. Answer ID: 6582 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 640/640=M-1429 It is lawful to use tongue cleaner but it is better to use miswak , for miswak cleans teeth as well as mouth and removes bad smell. It is also the Sunnah of the Prophet ( صلي الله عليه وسلم ) and a source of seeking Allah's pleasure. Besides these, miswak has enough advantages. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
